objective: Test one simple strictly PIT exposure-only V1-R candidate derived from the supported breadth/entry-opportunity mechanism, without changing frozen V1 membership selection, ranking, exits, or execution semantics.

regime_timestamp.first_applicable_execution: first causally valid open after t
regime_timestamp.missing_or_unknown: new-entry multiplier 0.0; no imputation, alternative breadth, or current-universe fallback
regime_timestamp.forbidden_transform: full-year ranks, pooled ranks, outcome labels, or future-normalized terciles

portfolio_application.scope: new member target weight only; frozen target weight is 10% before multiplier
portfolio_application.persistence: the target weight assigned on the member's entry-signal date remains sticky through that planned-member lifetime
portfolio_application.survivors: existing members keep their assigned target weight when another set change occurs
portfolio_application.zero_multiplier: the selected member creates no buy but reserves its frozen no-replacement slot until a normal V1 set-removal/market-exit event
unchanged: maximum ten planned members and no replacement
all exit signals and winner-hold remains off
sell-before-buy, board lot, 10 bps per filled side
corporate-action share/cash ledger and fail-closed behavior

frozen_arms.C0_ALL_ONE_CONTROL: multiplier 1.0 on every session including feature-missing sessions; must reproduce frozen V1 economics/executions
frozen_arms.A40_HALF_PRIMARY: multiplier 0.5 if raw breadth_above_ma20 < 0.40, otherwise 1.0; missing/unknown is 0.0
frozen_arms.N30_HALF_NEIGHBOR: multiplier 0.5 if raw breadth_above_ma20 < 0.30, otherwise 1.0; missing/unknown is 0.0
frozen_arms.N50_HALF_NEIGHBOR: multiplier 0.5 if raw breadth_above_ma20 < 0.50, otherwise 1.0; missing/unknown is 0.0
frozen_arms.Z40_ZERO_SEVERITY: multiplier 0.0 if raw breadth_above_ma20 < 0.40, otherwise 1.0; missing/unknown is 0.0

primary_metrics: block and calendar-year return and max drawdown
trade count, win/mean/median trade, severe-loss rate
average invested fraction, turnover, filled-side costs
Top-10/20 concentration, winner20/50 participation and P&L capture
false-breakout count/P&L when exact cycle matching is available
same-bar fill, stale valuation, and corporate-action audit
control_gate: C0 execution ledger and projected event/NAV ledgers must hash-match each frozen authoritative block and all baseline metrics must match at 1e-12; otherwise all candidate arms are invalid

promotion_gate.primary_only: A40_HALF_PRIMARY is judged before neighbors and may not be replaced by a better-looking arm
promotion_gate.bad_environment: improves 2022 return and does not worsen 2023 return by more than 2 percentage points
promotion_gate.drawdown: max drawdown is no worse in at least 2 of 3 independent blocks
promotion_gate.right_tail: retains at least 90% of baseline >=20% winner entries and at least 80% of baseline positive Top-20 P&L
promotion_gate.distribution: improves return ex-best20 in at least 2 of 3 blocks
promotion_gate.neighbors: N30 and N50 show the same direction for 2022 return and at least 2/3 block drawdowns; no arm is selected by CAGR
promotion_gate.classification: promotion only authorizes Phase 8 robustness; it is not a deployability PASS

forbidden: threshold/multiplier optimization or selecting a neighboring arm as primary
full-year percentile composite or future-normalized regime
entry-quality, ranking, market-gate, or exit changes
naive chaining of the three independently funded NAV blocks
production/live use, order generation, or untouched OOS claim
